description: DL-08 is the North West-I Zonal Office of the Delhi Transport Department located at the DTC Depot in Wazirpur. It is responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and permit issuance for a large portion of North West Delhi, including industrial and residential hubs. This RTO plays a crucial role in managing the heavy transport traffic associated with the Wazirpur Industrial Area.
address: Transport Department, Zonal Office North West-I, DTC Depot, Wazirpur, New Delhi
